title: Content Access Control: Let Only the Right Roles View a Page | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Some content is meant for one team only: a supervisor handbook, an internal price list, notes for a single department. Permissions normally cover a whole content type, so two pages of one type are open to the same people. The CrestApps Content Access Control module lets the editor pick, on each content item, the roles that may view it. Everyone else is refused that item, and the rest of the site stays open.

In this video:
• Why restrict content by role, and the problem with per-type permissions
• How the Role Picker part and the Restrict content setting work together
• Setting up a content type: adding the Role Picker and its options
• Restricting an item by picking roles, and lifting the restriction again
• Checking the result by signing in as a person with, and without, the role
• Four ways to use it
